what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 3 of 3: The no-memory region under light-cone formation with the true influence constant. GIVEN: two attempts claimed uniqueness for beta < 3/7 from ||Cov_vMF|| <= 1/3; the referee showed the step FAILS: the covariance bound makes the MEAN map (beta/3)-Lipschitz, but the Dobrushin/Wasserstein influence of one predecessor is the W1-Lipschitz constant of S -> vMF(beta S) (the sup over 1-Lipschitz f of Cov(f, u.s)), which the covariance does not control. Block 27 (PR #8171) has the total-variation sensitivity |V - V'|/(2 sqrt 3). TASK: the correct region. (a) Compute or bound the W1 influence of the vMF kernel exactly (at V = 0 the law is uniform: the optimal transport between vMF(V) and vMF(V') is explicit to first order); (b) give the uniqueness region for 7 predecessors by total variation (block 27: 7 beta/sqrt 3 < 1?) and by W1, and say which is larger; (c) compare with the executed onset of memory (between beta = 0.6 and 0.75 on 32^3 planes). Exact finite checks of every constant. ROUND 2: the first round's attempts and referee reports are under probes/work/derive/<problem>/ and logs/probes/J:derive:*/ and logs/probes/J:confirm:J-derive-*/ (python3 probes/harvest.py lists them); what survived refereeing is stated below as GIVEN, what failed is stated as the gap. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/lightcone-uniqueness-region/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/lightcone-uniqueness-region/<name>/check.py"
